The 2026 United States House of Representatives election in South Dakota is scheduled to be held on November 3, 2026, to elect a member of the United States House of Representatives to represent the state of South Dakota from its at-large congressional district. The election will coincide with other elections held on the same date. The primary elections will be held on June 2, 2026, and in races where no candidate receives at least 35% in a primary, runoff elections took place on July 28.[1]

Incumbent Republican representative Dusty Johnson was re-elected with 72.0% of the vote in 2024.[2]

Primary elections were held on June 2, 2026. Jackley received 79.2% of the vote against minimal opposition and Gronli ran unopposed for their respective party's nominations. Republicans have not lost a Congressional election in South Dakota since 2008.
